title: Description: When an iRule that processes client traffic using the PEM::subscriber command is configured on a virtual…
description: A vulnerability in the BIG-IP system occurs when an iRule using the PEM::subscriber command processes client traffic on a virtual server. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate, disrupting traffic and potentially allowing remote code execution (RCE). This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
